evidence.quote: For third‑party applications that need to access Sentry on behalf of users, Sentry supports OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type.
Authentication tokens are passed using an auth header, and are used to authenticate as a user or organization account with the API.
These auth tokens can be created within Sentry on the "User settings" page (**User settings > Personal Tokens**) and assigned specific scopes.
